title: Oct 13 Results + Oct 14 Preview: When You Go 0-1, You Own It
summary: Oct 13 was brutal (0-1). But Oct 14? Dodgers-Brewers is where we bounce back.

content.value:
## Let Me Be Honest: Yesterday Was Garbage

Look, I'm not here to sugarcoat anything. October 13 was a disaster. We went 0-1. That's a perfect zero percent success rate. The Guardians let us down against the Rays, and there's no spinning that into something positive. When you're wrong, you're wrong. Period.

## The Guardians Choked, Plain and Simple

A 50% confidence pick that missed? Yeah, it stings, but let's call it what it was—a coin flip that landed tails. The Guardians couldn't get it done in Tampa, and honestly, maybe we should've seen it coming. But here's the thing about being a Drama Critic: you take your losses on the chin and move forward with even hotter takes.

The model's not perfect. Never claimed it was. But one bad day doesn't define a season, and it sure as hell doesn't define what's coming tomorrow.

content.title: ⭐ Oct 14 Top Pick
content.value: Los Angeles Dodgers over Milwaukee Brewers

## Tomorrow's Redemption: Dodgers Are the Play

Here's where we get back on track. October 14 brings us Brewers at Dodgers, and I'm telling you right now—Los Angeles is the pick. 57% confidence might not sound like a lock, but when you've got Blake Snell on the mound at home versus Robert Gasser, the math starts making a lot more sense.

Snell's been elite when he's locked in, and Dodger Stadium is his fortress. Gasser? He's got potential, sure, but this is the postseason spotlight, and the Brewers are walking into a buzzsaw. Milwaukee's got fight, I'll give them that, but the Dodgers have championship DNA flowing through their veins right now.

## Why This Pick Matters

Let me be provocative for a second: if you're not riding with the Dodgers tomorrow, you're overthinking it. Yes, we missed yesterday. Yes, confidence is only at 57%. But this is about context. Home field advantage, superior pitching matchup, and a team that knows how to perform when the lights are brightest.

The Brewers are scrappy, but scrappy doesn't win championships. Talent does. Execution does. And tomorrow, the Dodgers have both in spades.

So yeah, October 13 was a disaster. But October 14? That's our bounce-back game. Book it.

## The Bottom Line

Zero wins yesterday hurts. No question. But if you're in this for the long game, you know one loss doesn't break the model. Tomorrow's slate is lean, but it's focused. Dodgers over Brewers. That's the play. That's the redemption arc.

Let's get back to winning. See you on the other side of October 14.

author: Rico
